$comment: TEST FIXTURE -- the EXECUTOR's repository. Shaped after the Next.js product repo in zheref/nen#91's design (its two-step lint, its multi-package coverage, its unsupported archive/release/deploy), with this fixture's own placeholder workspace names: nothing here is any real project's identity. Not shipped; see ../../README.md. The `web` lane is the one stack this release runs end to end; `native` exists so the unsupported-verb, host, placeholder and cannot-assert refusals each have a lane to be proved against.

web.why: The dependency install has been run. Nen ASSERTS it and never performs it: an install executes this project's own postinstall scripts. (The fixture carries deps/INSTALLED so this one is satisfied.)
Set by this project's own shell profile. Nen checks that the NAME is set and never reads, compares or prints the value.

native.why: Deliberately absent in this fixture: the unsatisfied-path refusal needs a lane to be proved against.
A kind this release cannot assert. It is reported as 'cannot assert' and refused -- never silently passed.

ui-test.why: Step 1 downloads a browser. It is part of the verb, not a precondition, because this project runs it every time.

lint.why: Two commands, in order. The second alone misses the repo-wide format check.

run.why: The production serve, locally. Its env VALUE is declared here and must never appear in any output nen produces.

archive.unsupported: no packaging step exists; this lane ships as a web application.

release.unsupported: there is no package or store pipeline for this lane.

deploy.unsupported: no target is wired. Declare one under `targets` before nen will run this.

storybook.why: An UNKNOWN verb name, preserved rather than rejected -- the ecosystem's verbs are the repository's to name. `nen shu` has no such subcommand, so nothing here can reach it.

build.why: One argv element carries whitespace, so the dry run's quoting is proved against a declaration rather than a synthetic string.

release.why: Declared, and restricted to one platform under `hosts` -- the exit-3 refusal needs a verb that is real everywhere except the host.

test.why: A placeholder this release cannot substitute -- the refusal is exit 2 naming it.

archive.unsupported: signing material is a human's, and nen never synthesises it.
